Panama-Netherlands Bilateral Investment Treaty, in force 1 September 2001

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework, as amended; incorporates FATF 40 Recommendations); Ley 254 de 30 de julio de 2021 and Decreto Ejecutivo 129 de 14 de junio de 2022 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales - RBF, administered by the Dirección General de Ingresos - DGI); Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas); Acuerdo No. 007-2015 of the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) and UAF resolutions as EDD benchmark standards

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent charter document) of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry / corporate registrar in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where origin state is an HCCH Contracting State) OR Consular Legalization at the competent Panamanian Embassy/Consulate (non-Hague states), followed by certified Spanish translation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 32 of 1927 (General Law on Corporations), as amended by Law No. 64 of 2014 and Law No. 5 of 2019; Articles 1-39 (formation), 56-70 (registered office and resident agent), and 71-88 (directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público de Panamá), Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Incorporación) submitted by a licensed resident agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital. The subscribed capital may be nominal (e.g., US$100 divided into 100 shares of no par value). Capital is not required to be paid up at formation, and no escrow account is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: We, the undersigned directors of Sociedad Anónima [Company Name], hereby resolve as follows. First: the subscription of the company's registered share capital, consisting of 100 common shares of no par value, is hereby confirmed and accepted by the founding shareholders. Second: the registered office of the corporation is adopted as the location set forth in the articles of incorporation, and a licensed resident agent is retained as required by Panamanian law. Third: the following persons are appointed as officers of the corporation: [President], [Treasurer], and [Secretary], each with sole and separate authority to execute contracts and sign corporate filings. This resolution is immediately effective and binds the corporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Resident Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público), Online Name Clearance Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a corporate name search via the online portal and reserve the approved Sociedad Anónima name. Execute a professional services agreement with a resident agent authorized by the Public Registry, specifying the registered office address in Panama and the agent's acceptance of statutory obligations.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (3 alternatives)
Valid passport copy of each incorporator and director
Proof of residential address of ultimate beneficial owner
Resident agent service agreement and acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar, promptly submit an alternative name or request an administrative reconsideration through the Registry's grievance office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público (Notary Public) in Panama City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct counsel to prepare the articles of incorporation and by-laws in Spanish. The incorporator(s) appear before the notary, execute the public deed, and the notary protocolizes the deed and issues an official protocol excerpt for submission.
required_dossiers: Fully drafted incorporation deed and by-laws
Original name reservation certificate
Directors' and resident agent's acceptance letters
Passport copies and signature exemplars
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any notarial or typographical errors on the spot; if a document is incomplete, the notary will reject and the parties re-execute after completing the dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá, Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the protocolized incorporation deed and required attachments through the Registry's e-filing platform or physically at the Mercantile Section. Pay the registration fee via approved channels and obtain a stamped filing receipt.
required_dossiers: Notarized official protocol excerpt
Incorporation deed original and two copies
Name clearance certificate
Payment receipt for registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a 'Nota de Defecto' (defect notice), cure the stated defects within 10 business days and resubmit. If the deadline lapses, file a reconsideration petition with supporting evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Legal Existence Certificate and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Registry Certification Unit)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, obtain the official Certificate of Legal Existence (Certificado de Registro). Execute the first board resolution appointing officers, approving the registered office, and ratifying all pre-incorporation acts. Record the resolution in the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Registration certificate
First board resolution signed by all directors
Incorporator's instruction letter
Corporate minute book and share ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the board resolution contains procedural defects, cure by obtaining unanimous shareholder written consent ratifying the appointments and acts retroactively.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance; Municipality of Panama (Municipio de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation with DGI to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) using the registration certificate and directors' passports. Afterwards, apply to the municipality for the operating notice (Aviso de Operación) and municipal tax registration, designating the physical business premises for distribution and storage.
required_dossiers: Registry Certificate of Legal Existence
Board resolution appointing the legal representative
Passport copies and tax ID photocopies of directors
Lease or property title of the registered office
Proof of mailing address and telephone
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI or the municipality rejects due to inconsistencies, amend the omission and resubmit; for excessive delay, present written remedy at the respective counters or seek administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sectoral Sanitary License for IVD Reagents Import and Distribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Salud de Panamá (MINSA), Dirección de Farmacia y Drogas; Dirección General de Regulación Sanitaria
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Sanitary Operating License (Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento) for the importation, storage, and distribution of in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) reagents. Submit the corporate license, RUC, and prove compliance with Good Storage and Distribution Practices (GSDP). Each reagent product requires separate sanitary registration as a medical device Class II/III.
required_dossiers: Corporate legal existence certificate and RUC
Municipal Aviso de Operación
Proof of premises compliance with GSDP
Product dossiers for each diagnostic reagent
Certificate of Pharmaceutical Free Sale from the country of origin (if applicable)
Spanish-language labeling and package inserts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon technical nonconformity, MINSA issues a deficiency report; the applicant has up to 30 calendar days to provide additional validation data. For repeated rejection, lodge an appeal invoking the Panamanian Administrative Procedure Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud de Panamá (MINSA) – Dirección de Farmacia y Drogas; joint jurisdiction with Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) for import permits
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento – Importación y Distribución de Reactivos de Diagnóstico in Vitro (Sanitary Operating License for Importation and Distribution of IVD Reagents)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I – Registration (Certificado de No Objeción/Registro Ambiental) for low-risk wholesale storage and distribution of diagnostic reagents
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Storage facilities must comply with Panamanian Technical Standard ENATI 160-2013 for solid waste and industrial hazardous waste handling; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions within occupational exposure limits per COSHE health standards; no discharge of reagent residues into municipal sewers unless recalibrated to tolerance limits set by the local aqueduct utility (IDAAN), with pH neutralization to 6-8 and trace chemical concentration below the National Discharge Standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá fire safety certificate (Certificado de Buen estado de seguridad y mantenimiento), structural load and building compliance certificate issued by the Ministry of Public Works (MOP) or authorized structural engineer, and occupational health clearance from the Social Security Occupational Health Department (Dirección General de Salud Ocupacional, CSS) verifying safe storage and handling procedures for regulated chemical reagents.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); e-tax portal: Sede Electrónica (https://sede.dgi.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident foreign entities must appoint a Panamanian resident legal representative or resident agent, provide notarized corporate documents with apostille (or legalization) and certified Spanish translation, obtain a resident agent certificate, and submit the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) application through the DGI Sede Electrónica or in person at the DGI branch. The process requires filing Form 021-RUC, presenting entity constitutive documents, and validating the local fiscal domicile. A digital signature token is also issued for e-invoicing and fiscal procedures. Entities without a permanent establishment may obtain an RUC for import/export compliance and invoicing obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not offer a check-the-box entity classification election for private limited companies (Sociedad Anónima); all corporations are taxable entities under national law. There is no elective pass-through regime and no hybrid mismatch election. Foreign taxpayers may elect to be taxed on a remittance basis through withholding at source when no permanent establishment is maintained, while resident corporations are taxed territorially on Panamanian-source income.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) - VAT-type transaction tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general economic turnover threshold exists; any person carrying out taxable supplies of goods or services in Panama must register for ITBMS. Small taxpayers with annual gross income not exceeding PAB 36,000 may benefit from the simplified monthly regime, but registration remains mandatory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama requires phased mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) through the DGI Sede Electrónica. Invoices must be transmitted in real time before issuance and obtain fiscal authorization from the DGI; the system requires compliant XML data structure, digital signature certificate, and a fiscal code or electronic stamp. Large taxpayers are already in scope, with mandatory rollout extended to all registered taxpayers. The DGI performs automated validation and denial of non-compliant invoices. For import/export operations, the Panama Customs Single Window (VUPA) also electronically links goods declarations to the taxpayer RUC.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Wholesale exports of IVD diagnostic reagents and assays from Panama to non-resident buyers are eligible for the 0% ITBMS rate, provided the goods physically leave Panamanian territory, an export sale is documented through a purchase order and invoice, and the exporter maintains proof of departure. Services physically performed abroad or directly in connection with international transport of exported goods may also be zero-rated. Domestic sales of the same reagents within Panama are subject to 7% ITBMS.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Formulario de Exportación/DEX) validated by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas de Panamá
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure
Commercial Invoice with Incoterms and IVD device references
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank document confirming receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI audits export transactions using Panama Customs export records, bank remittance data, and beneficiary manifests. Where the 0% rate is claimed fraudulently or without actual physical export, the taxpayer is subject to immediate reassessment of the omitted 7% ITBMS, late payment surcharge (recargo), compensatory interest, and fines of up to 100% of the tax due. Willful false export declarations may constitute tax evasion under the Código Fiscal de Panamá and can trigger criminal prosecution, monetary penalties up to PAB 50,000, and the temporary suspension or revocation of the RUC and operating licenses.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of Panama has no central bank of issue; monetary authority is effectively exercised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (Superintendency of Banks of Panama, SBP) for banking supervision, while the U.S. Federal Reserve System supplies the circulating monetary base through full dollarization. The U.S. dollar (USD) is legal tender for all public and private obligations; fractional Balboa (PAB) coinage is minted by the Ministry of Economy and Finance at fixed 1:1 parity with the USD.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama maintains full and unrestricted currency convertibility across both current and capital accounts because the USD is the statutory circulating currency. There are no exchange-control laws, no central-bank authorization for foreign-exchange transactions, and no capital-account restrictions. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted and Panama's territorial income-tax system imposes no withholding tax on outbound dividends. The only formalities are banking-level anti-money-laundering documentation under Law 23 of 2015, BPM6 balance-of-payments statistical classification of each wire by the SBP-licensed bank, and OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS) reporting of account-holder tax residence. A non-resident-owned S.A. may hold accounts in USD without valuation, conversion, or repatriation hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no mandatory export-proceeds repatriation timeline, no percentage-based surrender quotient, and no statutory requirement to convert export receipts into local currency. A Panamanian seller may retain export proceeds in offshore USD accounts or convert them into any foreign currency freely. However, under Law 23/2015 and SBP AML guidelines, the S.A. must preserve underlying commercial documentation for each export transaction so that the account-holding bank or the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) can verify the legitimacy of the funds upon request.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banco Nacional de Panamá (state-owned commercial bank)
Banco General, S.A. (largest private bank in Panama)
Caja de Ahorros (state-owned savings and banking institution)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium. Panama is not a member of the European economic-area e-money institution (EMI) passporting regime and maintains no equivalent principal EMI licence. Panamanian law recognizes payment-service companies under SBP payment-systems rules, but these entities may not hold unrestricted corporate operational funds as full commercial banks. Offshore digital EMIs licensed in the United Kingdom, Lithuania, or other EU/EEA states can be used only as auxiliary vendor-payment rails and are generally discouraged for a distributor of regulated IVD reagents because of correspondent-bank de-risking, the residual compliance legacy of the 2019-2023 FATF grey-listing, and the absence of a Panama-domiciled settlement account. The recommended treasury architecture is to use SWIFT MT103 clearing through a tier-1 local account and to restrict EMI usage to minor auxiliary expenses with an approved transaction cap.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Neither Decreto Ley 2/2012 nor Law 23/2015 contains an explicit statutory mandate requiring physical presence; however, SBP AML prudential rules and each bank's internal customer-risk classification effectively control the onboarding outcome. For a newly incorporated S.A. with 100% non-resident beneficial ownership and no audited financial history, the market-standard practice of Banco General, Banistmo, and BAC International is to require an in-person interview at a Panamanian branch of at least one authorised signatory holding legal-representative capacity. Some High-tier banks accept hybrid onboarding using an Apostilled notarised power of attorney combined with a live video call, but the attestation of the registered Resident Agent remains mandatory. Pure remote opening with e-signature is typically accepted only where the corporate existence exceeds two years, the MINSA sanitary licence is verifiable, and the compliance committee receives a sworn source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: newly formed PA_CORP S.A. with nil operating history requesting immediate capital-escrow and operational account activation, triggering shell-company detection scoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: (i) Protocolo de Constitución (articles of incorporation) bearing the authentication of the registered Resident Agent; (ii) certified copy of the share-certificate register evidencing legal ownership; (iii) UBO declaration on the statutory form required by Law 23/2015; (iv) notarised Board of Directors resolution designating authorised signatories and defining the precise account purpose; (v) certified Aviso de Operación issued by the Registro Público together with the municipal operation permit; (vi) completed bank questionnaire on expected monthly volume and turnover of ELISA reagent distribution; (vii) sworn source-of-funds statement of the initial capital contributor supported by bank reference letters from the remitting financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: regulated medical-goods vertical (clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents under ISIC 4649 / NAICS 424690) presented without evidentiary proof of the sanitary import and distribution licence, leading to enhanced risk classification or rejection by the compliance unit.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: (i) Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) sanitary registration or import authorisation for in-vitro diagnostic reagents under Panama's applicable medical-devices and health-products regulation; (ii) product registration certificates for each ELISA reagent catalogue item; (iii) executed supply contract or pro-forma invoice identifying each SKU with HS tariff classification; (iv) ISO 13485 certificate of the reagent manufacturer and ISO 9001 quality evidence of the distributor; (v) written distribution-model description demonstrating zero retail-cash exposure; (vi) reference letters from the Panama-domiciled freight forwarder and customs broker evidencing demonstrable import volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: FATF/CFATF grey-list legacy (2019-2023) coupled with concentrated non-resident ownership, triggering enhanced due diligence, PEP screening, and elevated correspondent-bank scrutiny of the account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: (i) complete beneficial-ownership chain chart with valid passports and tax-residence certificates of all natural-person beneficiaries; (ii) sworn declaration that the beneficiaries are not Politically Exposed Persons, or, if any are, a legally supported PEP risk-mitigation memorandum; (iii) updated corporate-diligence certificate from the Resident Agent confirming no insolvency, liquidation, or judicial process; (iv) projected balance sheet and 12-month cash-flow forecast demonstrating active wholesale-distribution operations; (v) written submission referencing Panama's post-grey-list beneficial-ownership transparency reforms and the SBP Circular on correspondent-account hygiene; (vi) signed engagement letter committing to annual audited or compiled financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: trade-route complexity — procurement from Asian reagent manufacturers and re-distribution to Latin American reference laboratories — creating invoice-mismatch and trade-based money-laundering suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: (i) executed master supply agreements with reagent manufacturers specifying INCOTERMS and transfer pricing terms; (ii) complete set of trade documents for an initial benchmark transaction (commercial invoices, packing lists, air or sea waybill, certificate of origin); (iii) bank reference letters from the Asian suppliers' relationship banks; (iv) end-customer purchase orders from laboratories, hospitals, and regulated distributors proving the commercial substance of each leg; (v) pricing-analysis worksheet documenting arm's-length margins between purchase and resale prices; (vi) MINSA import permits and customs declarations for each shipment; (vii) a written standard operating procedure stating that the S.A. accepts only SWIFT or Letter-of-Credit settlement and maintains no cash-handling infrastructure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder-loan injections into the PA_CORP S.A. are executed by ordinary SWIFT MT103 credit transfers in USD from the contributor's account to the designated SBP-licensed bank. No exchange-control approval or central-bank clearance is required in Panama because of full dollarization; the receiving bank, however, requires (i) the statutory Declaración de Origen de Fondos (source-of-funds declaration), (ii) a board resolution or capital-increase minute if subscribed shares are being issued, (iii) the use of a standard BPM6 purpose description such as 'equity injection into non-resident direct-investment enterprise for working capital', and (iv) an active MINSA sanitary licence and municipal Aviso de Operación on the instruction date to avoid compliance seizure. Correspondent banks favour a single treasury bank in Panama with clean UBO records and a 30-day advance notice of the first high-value injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for ELISA reagent inventory is executed through (i) direct SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for open-account suppliers with 30-60 day payment terms, (ii) irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued via MT700 and amended via MT707 for large or first-time supplier contracts, preferably confirmed by the supplier's correspondent bank under UCP 600, (iii) documentary collections (DP/DA) for mid-value shipments, and (iv) SWIFT MT798 structured-message trade applications where the SBP-licensed bank operates a specialised trade desk. Payment rails remain strictly limited to Swift_Wire and TT_Payment per the treasury policy; cryptocurrency transfers, cash courier, and third-party payment portals are excluded. Controls require a single authorised signatory for disbursements below USD 100,000 and dual signatures plus compliance pre-screening of the beneficiary bank for any payment above that threshold.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla OTC deliverable forward contracts on USD/EUR and USD/CNY to hedge purchase flows from European and Chinese ELISA reagent manufacturers; no FX-control approval is required under Panama's dollarised regime, although ISDA or equivalent master documentation is mandated by SBP-regulated counterparties.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on regional Latin American currencies such as USD/COP, USD/BRL, and USD/MXN to protect re-export revenue collections from health-sector buyers in Colombia, Brazil, and Mexico.

Cross-currency swaps for medium-term intercompany financing or supplier match-funding structures, executed under ISDA documentation with a licensed international bank and reported to the SBP within the bank's derivatives risk-management framework.

OTC foreign-exchange option purchases (European-style, bought options only, no naked option sales) on EUR and CNY with tenures of 3 to 12 months, subject to a board-approved derivatives policy and suitability assessment by the account-holding bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly surcharge of 1.5% plus legal interest; persistent non-payment for three consecutive years results in administrative strike-off by the Public Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31, unless an official grace period is published by the Registry Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Loss of good standing; corporate documents blocked for registration; fines from USD 50 to USD 1,000 plus reinstatement fees may apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Annual Confirmation (Declaración Anual de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección Nacional de Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (DNRBF) within DGI, Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days of incorporation anniversary, or within 15 business days after any change of shareholding or control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from USD 500 to USD 5,000 per violation; suspension of corporate registry transaction capacity until rectification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta) or Tax Non-Subject Declaration (Nota de Abstención) for no Panamanian-source income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 for calendar-year corporations; otherwise within three months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of 5% to 50% of the amount due, monthly monetary interest, and temporary suspension of tax clearance certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is compulsory when gross annual revenue exceeds USD 1,000,000, total assets exceed USD 3,000,000, when the entity is a DGI-classified large taxpayer (Mayor Contribuyente), or when a shareholder or bank requires audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; IFRS for SMEs permitted for non-publicly accountable entities; local GAAP only accepted when explicitly approved by the DGI for tax purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Panama S.A. must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register and file an annual declaration with the DNRBF by the incorporation anniversary. Any shareholding transfer, including issuance or disposition of shares, must be updated in the register and reported within 15 business days. The annual UBO confirmation must reconcile with the current shareholders register before any corporate filing is accepted by the Public Registry.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 7,500 (only if audit threshold is triggered)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territoriality is the controlling relief: income derived from foreign-source commercial operations (including international resale of diagnostic reagents) is excluded from the Panamanian ISR base; only Panamanian-source net income is taxed at 25%. No reduced corporate band or general tax holiday applies to an unlicensed wholesale S.A.; special regimes (Colon Free Zone, Panama Pacifico) may exempt 90-100% but are not activated for this entity.
